baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal يَوْمَ governs يَقُومُ with visible humanity as subject and لِرَبِّ as the authority-facing relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: A severe occasion dislodges humanity from repose into bodily and resurrectional uprightness; the movement culminates in a publicly present assembly under lordship.

activation_trace.role: The event-day or severe occasion makes the time word a decisive occurrence rather than an ordinary date.
Bodily rising supplies the concrete transition into upright presence.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour widen one bodily motion into the universal event.
Visible human presence makes the subject an exposed human assembly rather than an anonymous mass.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the pole before which the assembly stands.

changed_reading.before: A calendar day on which people happen to be standing.
changed_reading.after: A decisive occurrence raises humanity into visible assembly under sovereign authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb يَقُومُ carries branches of valuation and equal weight, while رَبِّ carries ownership and عَٰلَمِينَ carries the image of distinguishing marks.
baseline_models.mechanism: Standing can function as being set at a value and brought to an even standard: marked differences remain legible, but every person becomes commensurable before one owner.

activation_trace.role: Value, valuation, and pricing open an appraisal function inside the standing verb.
Equal weight and even measure supply the rule by which the assembled humans become comparable.
Ownership makes the valuation answerable to a single authoritative possessor.
The distinguishing-mark image keeps identities and orders readable within universal equalization.

changed_reading.after: Humanity is set upright and simultaneously set to value under an even, universally legible standard.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلنَّاسُ names visible human presence; يَقُومُ can stage confrontation; the ع ل م branches join clarity to marks.
baseline_models.mechanism: The assembly is an epistemic exposure: people emerge from social anonymity into faceable, marked, and knowable presence before the Lord.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies emergence from hiddenness as the subject's defining condition.
Opposition and facing off turn uprightness into being placed directly before another.
Knowing through clarification gives the exposure an epistemic result.
A distinguishing mark makes each exposed presence identifiable rather than merely visible.

changed_reading.before: People form a generic crowd before God.
changed_reading.after: Every human presence is made faceable, distinguishable, and knowable before the Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَوْمَ can be an open duration, يَقُومُ can name both a station and what sustains a thing, and رَبِّ can name nurture and completion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause need not be a momentary rise only: humanity is held through a duration at a station, and that very capacity to remain standing discloses dependence on the one who sustains and completes it.

activation_trace.role: An open span of time permits a durative station rather than a punctual gesture.
Station and residence spatialize the standing as an assigned place of remaining.
Support and subsistence make standing dependent on what keeps a being in existence.
Repair, nurture, and completion identify lordship as the sustaining relation exposed by the station.

changed_reading.before: Humanity performs one act of rising.
changed_reading.after: Humanity is maintained through an assigned duration, revealing that even its standing depends on lordly nurture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening exchange first makes people the counterpart against whom full measure is taken and short measure is given. That asymmetry activates valuation and equal-measure branches inside يَقُومُ, so the later subject 'the people' becomes the very population remeasured by the standard they distorted.

activation_trace.role: Valuation turns standing into the setting of human worth or liability.
Equal weight and even measure provide the corrective norm hidden in the focus verb.
Measuring food supplies the concrete practice whose asymmetry is transferred to human appraisal.
Completion without deficiency marks what the actors demand for themselves and what the final measure restores.
Comparison between two matters exposes the relational, two-sided character of measurement.
The balance of justice converts quantity into a norm of equitable adjudication.
Shorting measure names the distortion that the focus assembly functionally reverses.

structural_cues: 83:2 and 83:3 mirror taking from people against measuring out to them; the object 'people' then becomes the subject of 83:6.
The ط ف ف occurrence at 83:1 is used only as a branchless structural heading for the asymmetry; no branch identifier is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: paired measuring, full taking, shorting, and q-w-m valuation/equal-measure images. Reader arrow: the commercial standard is applied back to the human agents when they stand. Live alternative: they stand bodily and are assessed only afterward.

changed_reading.before: People stand as spectators or defendants at a future event.
changed_reading.after: The people once used as units in unequal exchange become the measured subjects, set to an even standard before the Owner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question about expectation supplies an inferential threshold, while بعث supplies the stirring of what was still and the next ayah names a severe occurrence. Together they select the resurrection branch of يَقُومُ without exhausting its other live functions.

activation_trace.role: Resurrection and the Hour provide the focus verb's direct event-scale realization.
The severe event-day makes the temporal frame an occurrence that falls upon its participants.
Certainty after an indication makes the question accuse a refused inference, not mere lack of information.
Stirring the still from repose supplies the causal transition into rising.
The adjacent event-day directly sharpens the identical focus root toward a calamitous occasion.
A great descending calamity gives the rising its pressure and scale.

structural_cues: The interrogative 83:4, the fragmentary amplification 83:5, and the completing relative event in 83:6 form one mounting sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: indicated certainty, stirring from stillness, a severe event, and resurrectional q-w-m. Reader arrow: the stirring causes the universal rising and makes refusal to expect it culpable. Live alternative: بعث denotes dispatch to a court rather than reanimation.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes attendance at an unspecified tribunal.
changed_reading.after: A signaled but resisted certainty arrives as a severe event that stirs all humanity out of repose into resurrection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Book, confinement, and inscription convert the assembly into a documentary placement system. A person does not merely stand in a crowd; each stands as a legible entry whose mark fixes a station and can place that entry within a constraining order.

activation_trace.role: Station and residence give each standing person a locatable placement.
A distinguishing mark makes the station and its occupant resolvably identifiable.
Entering a name into a register supplies the operation that converts persons into docketed entries.
Confinement in a holding place gives one documentary placement a spatial consequence.
A numbered or written line in a register makes the placement durable and readable.

structural_cues: 83:7 names a book and a containing location, 83:8 suspends comprehension, and 83:9 resolves the object as a marked book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: registered names, confinement, inscription, a q-w-m station, and an ع ل م mark. Reader arrow: the record assigns and stabilizes where each person stands. Live alternative: the record merely reports a destination fixed by another process.

changed_reading.before: Universal standing is an undifferentiated mass event.
changed_reading.after: Each human stands as a marked, docketed presence whose record fixes a consequential station.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accounting/recompense and financial debt recode equalizing valuation as settlement. Crossing the limit creates an imbalance, while the ء ث م image of delay from good makes liability temporally overdue; standing is the moment at which the deferred account comes due.

activation_trace.role: Valuation supplies the assessment needed before settlement.
Even measure supplies the restored balance toward which settlement moves.
Accounting and recompense make the day an occasion of reckoning and return.
Financial debt turns abstract accountability into an outstanding relational claim.
Exceeding a boundary identifies how the account became unbalanced.
Delay from good gives the debt a temporal dimension of withheld performance.

structural_cues: The repeated denial in 83:10-12 surrounds the explicit phrase 'day of dīn', linking refusal to the unpaid account.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: accounting, debt, limit-crossing, delay, and q-w-m valuation/equal measure. Reader arrow: violated measure becomes liability that matures at the standing. Live alternative: debt is only an analogy for recompense, not a distinct legal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Humans are appraised at a tribunal.
changed_reading.after: Humans stand when deferred obligations mature, violated limits are priced, and an unequal account is brought back to balance.

context_deltas.mechanism: What people acquire becomes an enclosing condition with no exit, followed by a barrier that blocks access to their Lord. Against this, the focus combination of visible humanity, clarification, and standing face-to-face becomes forced disclosure: accumulated concealment can no longer mediate the relation.

activation_trace.role: Visible human presence supplies the exposed state opposed to covering.
Knowing as clarification gives exposure the result of undeniable legibility.
Lordship identifies the relation from which concealment had blocked access.
An enclosing fall with no exit models acquired acts becoming a trapping overlay.
Acquiring gain supplies the repeated input from which the enclosing condition accumulates.
The repeated lordship root directly reconnects the barrier sequence to the focus relation.
Prevention of access supplies the relational effect of the covering.
A screening barrier supplies the spatial image that focus-standing overturns.

structural_cues: 83:14 sequences earning into an overlay on hearts; 83:15 then turns that inner overlay into blocked access to the same ر ب ب relation named in 83:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: acquisition, inescapable overlay, barrier, repeated lordship, and visible/knowable focus humanity. Reader arrow: standing before the Lord removes the mediating cover and exposes the accumulated self. Live alternative: the veil is deprivation of favor, not forensic disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Humanity is simply visible because it has assembled.
changed_reading.after: Humanity is forced into legibility after its acquisitions had thickened into a cover that blocked the Lord-facing relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The second marked register mirrors the first but is placed in elevation, then witnessed by those with privileged nearness. This revises documentary stationing into a vertically differentiated, socially witnessed order rather than a flat registry.

activation_trace.role: Station and residence let the assembly distribute into differentiated placements.
Distinguishing marks keep the plural orders and their occupants legible.
Enrollment in a register supplies membership in the contrasting upper order.
Elevation supplies the vertical axis that differentiates this register from confinement below.
Presence with direct witnessing makes placement publicly attested rather than privately filed.
Privileged nearness to a king supplies the courtly position of the witnesses.

structural_cues: The lower book sequence at 83:7-9 and upper book sequence at 83:18-21 repeat the same marked-book formula around opposite placement images.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: mirrored registers, confinement, elevation, witnessed presence, and royal nearness. Reader arrow: the focus assembly resolves into attested stations within a vertical court order. Live alternative: lower and upper are status metaphors with no spatial assignment.

changed_reading.before: All people stand on one undifferentiated plane before the Lord.
changed_reading.after: The universal assembly is sorted into marked stations along a vertical order, with placement witnessed from privileged nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later chain of good condition, watering, life-maintaining water, spring, and drinking materializes the focus branches of support and nurture. The standing is therefore also a disclosure of creaturely dependence, and the later provision answers that dependence for one order of the assembled.

activation_trace.role: Support and subsistence make the ability to stand a maintained condition.
Nurture and completion supply the relation that maintains dependent life.
Good condition and benefit identify the sustained state reached by the upright.
Giving drink supplies the concrete act by which dependence is answered.
Water by which the self is maintained links provision directly to continued life.
A flowing spring provides a continuing source rather than a one-time allotment.
Taking in liquid completes the transfer from sustaining source to dependent person.

structural_cues: 83:22-28 descends from a state of نعيم through sealed drink and mixture to a named spring and the act of drinking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: q-w-m subsistence, r-b-b nurture, and a sequenced provision of life-maintaining drink. Reader arrow: the provision reveals and answers the dependence already implicit in standing for the Lord. Live alternative: the drink is subsequent reward and does not explain the focus standing.

changed_reading.before: Standing is a self-contained act performed by autonomous agents.
changed_reading.after: The station reveals that human uprightness is maintained by lordly nurture, later rendered materially as sustaining provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earthly spectators see, label, and laugh at another group; inversion then returns laughter and looking in the opposite direction. This activates q-w-m confrontation and visible human presence: the focus standing adjudicates not only persons but the social gaze by which persons had presumed to mark one another.

activation_trace.role: Opposition and facing off convert standing into an encounter between previously unequal observers.
Visible human presence makes every observer also available to be observed.
The distinguishing-mark image supplies the contested act of classifying who is astray.
Joy or surprise displayed in laughter makes contempt publicly visible.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the reversal operation later applied to the gaze.
Seeing by eye or insight identifies the judgment as an act of perception.
Deviation from guidance is the label the earthly observers presume to assign.
The repeated laughter image in the opposite subject position makes reversal explicit.
Things facing until each sees the other completes the reciprocal visibility.

structural_cues: 83:29-32 and 83:34-35 reverse the subjects of laughing and looking.
The غ م ز occurrence at 83:30 is retained only as a branchless structural gesture in the contempt sequence; no mapped root or branch is invented for it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: visible laughter, turning, seeing, labeling as astray, reciprocal facing, and q-w-m confrontation. Reader arrow: universal standing reverses and judges the social gaze itself. Live alternative: the reversal is emotional recompense without a confrontation mechanism in 83:6.

changed_reading.before: Standing makes everyone visible to the Lord alone.
changed_reading.after: Standing also makes former spectators answerable as seen persons, reversing the gaze by which they had classified and mocked others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The denial that mockers were sent as guardians activates two less obvious q-w-m branches: standing over something as guardian and standing in another's place. The focus then levels human authority: all people stand for the Lord, while no peer group occupies the Lord's supervisory position over another.

activation_trace.role: Care, guardianship, and governance expose a supervisory sense latent in q-w-m.
Standing in another's place frames human surveillance as an unauthorized claim to delegated authority.
Lordship reserves final ownership and governance to the focus authority.
Sending and dispatch supply the commission explicitly negated by the sentence.
Guarding and watching define the office that the mockers were never given.

structural_cues: 83:33 uses a negative passive commission immediately before the reversal of observers in 83:34.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a negated dispatch as guardians, q-w-m guardianship/substitution, and r-b-b lordship. Reader arrow: the focus assembly withdraws peer claims to stand over others and places everyone on the subject side of authority. Live alternative: 83:33 limits only one historical act of mockery, not human guardianship generally.

changed_reading.before: People stand before a sovereign while retaining their earthly ranks over one another.
changed_reading.after: All humans stand on the governed side of lordship; no mocking subgroup was commissioned to occupy a supervisory place over another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing question defines recompense as an action returning to its actor. That return closes the valuation circuit opened by unequal exchange: at the focus standing, deeds are not external exhibits but values and consequences that come back to constitute the doer.

activation_trace.role: Valuation makes the returning action count toward the standing person's assessed condition.
The decisive event supplies the point at which delayed consequences return.
The recompense of work returning to its worker supplies the feedback direction.
Bringing about an act supplies what enters and eventually returns through the circuit.

structural_cues: The surah closes with a passive recompense question whose object is exactly what the actors had been doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: action, recompense as return to the worker, a decisive day, and q-w-m valuation. Reader arrow: the act returns as part of the actor's standing value and consequence. Live alternative: recompense corresponds to action without the action itself constituting the person.

changed_reading.before: People stand while an external judge reviews past acts.
changed_reading.after: People stand inside a closed return circuit in which what they enacted comes back as their assessed condition and consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ر ب و target in the split mapping of focus ر ب ب. It remains packet-anchored because that target explicitly carries transactional surplus and the opening supplies measurement and just balance, but it must be rendered only as a secondary echo; it must never redefine رَبِّ as usury or replace the dominant lordship reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus رَبِّ has a packet-supplied split target whose surplus branch sits beside q-w-m valuation.

activation_trace.role: Usurious surplus supplies a distant transactional resonance inside the packet's non-dominant mapping.
Valuation gives the surplus echo a focus-anchored adjudicative function.
Concrete measuring activates the otherwise remote transactional branch.
The just balance supplies the norm against which extracted surplus is exposed.

changed_reading.before: رَبِّ contributes only the sovereign title.
changed_reading.after: Without changing that title, the split inventory lets illicit surplus faintly reverberate in the scene where all human valuations are corrected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is odd because the focus form conventionally names worlds while the activated branch concerns a distinguishing mark. It remains anchored in the ع ل م inventory and is independently activated by marked registers and witness-bearing signs; downstream prose should say the worlds become readable or sign-bearing, not claim that عَٰلَمِينَ literally means written marks here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final focus word عَٰلَمِينَ carries the branch image of a mark that distinguishes and guides toward its referent.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark lets each world or order be heard as sign-bearing and identifiable.
Enrollment in a register makes membership in an order explicitly readable.
Visible inscription or ornament activates the focus image of differentiation by a mark.
A sign that bears witness lets marks function as evidence rather than decoration.

changed_reading.before: The worlds are an unarticulated cosmic totality.
changed_reading.after: The worlds coexist as distinguishable, sign-bearing orders whose marks make every placement readable before their Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the tiny human image in the pupil from the ن و س inventory and extends it through later eye, mirror, and facing branches. It remains anchored to ٱلنَّاسُ and the packet's repeated looking sequence, but it should be presented as a visual-material analogy for reciprocal exposure, never as a lexical translation of 'people.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus subject ٱلنَّاسُ carries a branch image of the little human figure visible in the pupil.

activation_trace.role: The miniature human image in the pupil materializes how a person appears inside another's gaze.
The seeing eye supplies the physical surface in which the human image is caught.
View, appearance, and mirror extend the pupil image into a scene of reflected judgment.
Mutual facing until each sees the other turns one-way scrutiny into reciprocal exposure.

changed_reading.before: Humanity stands as an externally observed crowd.
changed_reading.after: Each human also appears as an image caught in another's gaze, until the assembly reverses one-way observation into mutual exposure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant convergence of q-w-m's noon-standing and brisk-market branches with w-z-n's balance of the day at its midpoint. The transactional opening visibly activates it and the focus supplies both day and standing, but prose must qualify it as an imagistic resonance of accounts reaching their high point, not translate يَقُومُ as a market opening or noon arriving.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacent focus words يَوْمَ and يَقُومُ permit the packet's day, midday-standing, and market-activity images to touch.

activation_trace.role: The bounded daylight span provides the temporal field for a midpoint image.
Noon height and midday standing place the event at a figurative point of maximal exposure.
Market briskness lets the opening commerce reverberate inside the standing event.
Food measurement activates the market domain without importing it from outside the packet.
The balance of daylight at its midpoint links weighing to the high point of the day.

changed_reading.before: The day of standing is temporally abstract and detached from the opening marketplace.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, the market reaches its high balanced point and every account becomes active when humanity stands.

strongest_changes: The physical rising became a reciprocal remeasurement in which people who distorted measure are themselves set to an even value.
The assembly became an inscribed, vertically differentiated placement witnessed within a courtly order.
Visible humanity became forced disclosure after acquired covering, and the social gaze itself was reversed and judged.
The final return of action to its actor closed the same valuation circuit opened by unequal exchange.
summary.what_was_special: The unusually polysemous q-w-m inventory let one focus verb retain bodily resurrection while also supporting valuation, equal measure, station, subsistence, confrontation, and undelegated guardianship. Context activated these functions in sequence rather than forcing them into one compromise reading; split-root and visual-material resonances were retained with explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Valuation and equal-weight branches may be contextual resonances around يَقُومُ rather than live senses of this verbal form.
The sign-bearing reading of عَٰلَمِينَ may illuminate the plural worlds without determining their lexical sense.
The lower and upper stations may be spatial, juridical, social, or several of these at once.
The non-dominant ر ب و surplus activation must remain an echo and cannot compete with the dominant lordship mapping.
